title: aspidium grammatosorus

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
